name: vanshavali

scripts.//db:diff: Generate a migration in supabase/migrations/ from edits to supabase/schemas/*.sql. Pass a name: `npm run db:diff -- <name>`. Local (uses a shadow DB).
scripts.//db:migrate: Apply pending migrations to the LOCAL db WITHOUT wiping data. The everyday 'apply the migration I just generated' command.
scripts.//db:reset: Drop + recreate the LOCAL db (WIPES DATA), re-applying all migrations + seed. For a clean slate or after editing an already-applied migration; re-run db:extras after.
scripts.//db:push: Apply pending migrations to the LINKED CLOUD project (run `supabase link` first). The deliberate deploy-to-cloud step.
scripts.//db:extras: Ensure the 'images' storage bucket exists on the active env (follows NEXT_PUBLIC_ENV). The one setup step migrations can't express.
scripts.//stack:start: Start the local Supabase stack in Docker; auto-applies migrations on boot.
scripts.//stack:stop: Stop the local stack, keeping the database (backed up, restored on next start).
scripts.//stack:status: Print local stack URLs + keys (API URL, anon key, DB URL, Studio, Mailpit).
scripts.//stack:reset: Nuke the local stack + database (--no-backup) and restart fresh; re-run db:extras after.
